decision_fields.description: State why the decision was made.
decision_fields.name: reason

decision_fields.description: State when the decision should be revisited.
decision_fields.name: reversal_condition

evidence_expectations: Each entry should reference the feature, project, and affected surfaces.
reversal_conditions: A real blocker appears, or new evidence invalidates the original choice.

expected_outputs.description: Validated decision log template for Decision Log Template.
expected_outputs.name: decision_log

implementation_notes: Record the reason and reversal condition in the same artifact so future agents can audit the choice.
Rejected alternatives matter; otherwise the log becomes decorative metadata.
known_failure_modes: Decision Log Template records the decision but not the reason, so future agents reverse it casually.
No reversal condition is captured, so the log cannot age gracefully.
name: Decision Log Template
problem_solved: Prevents architectural archaeology when Decision Log Template changes over time.
summary: Machine-first template for durable design decisions.
when_not_to_use: Do not use when Decision Log Template is trivial and no meaningful alternative or reversal condition exists.
Do not use when a locked project-level decision log already captures the same choice.
when_to_use: Use when Decision Log Template introduces a choice that future agents might otherwise unknowingly reverse.
Use when the reason, rejected alternatives, and reversal condition need to remain queryable.
